name: r5 monthly system — 70/30 trend-ballast
selected: 2026-09-01 (declared); 2026-09-05 (the screened bundle added, features); 2026-09-06 (the generated bundle replaces it, features + formulas)
provenance: Owner-declared champion after the 4-week rebuild campaign (AGENTS.md 9h and ledger r4w_*/r5pkg_* entries). Supersedes ext-t20 weekly champion (its edge was confined to 2001-2012). Pre-holdout record 2006-2024 as deployed (selection.simulate on the live ledger rules since 2026-09-03: fills at the next open, 5 bp a side; the walk from 2001-06, ranks before the holdout): with the screened bundle (adopted 2026-09-05, ledger champion_r5_7030_cap2_bundle) $3,058 (+20.2%/yr, SR 0.85, DD 59%) vs SPY $628 (+10.4%/yr, SR 0.64, DD 55%), 2006-01 -> 2024-07, 968 credited weeks — asterisk: the bundle's candidate ideas were written from the whole 2006-2024 record; before the bundle $1,553 (+15.9%/yr, SR 0.72, DD 62%) vs SPY $623 on the clean walk's 1195 rank weeks (2006-01 -> 2024-06; the bundle on those same weeks $3,092; ledger champion_r5_7030_cap2_regraded, reports/fill_basis_regrade.md); on the close basis with the fixed rank-date join (commit dccca9a; reports/rank_date_regrade.md) the clean line read $1,644 (+16.3%/yr), and before the fix $1,586 vs $563. 2024-07-19+ holdout deliberately unspent. 2026-09-06: the generated bundle (features_note) replaced the ideas bundle on the owner's decision; the champion's pre-holdout record with it is the v3 arm's grade (walk from 2006-01): $3,498 (+21.1%/yr, SR 0.88, DD 50%) vs SPY $608, 2006-01 -> 2024-07, 967 rank weeks; 2016-01 -> 2024-07 $863 vs clean $590 vs ideas $772 vs SPY $310. No asterisk.

model.summary: simple-DT: depth-3 gbtree, untuned by design (config search measured as noise)

horizon.label: label_4w
horizon.rationale: feature probe + population exams: month-ahead signal real (t>2), week-ahead dead since ~2004

training_window_rationale: style-cycle whipsaw protection; directionally better in both whipsaw eras, never worse; robustness pick within noise band

ensemble.k_copies_note: 16 since 2026-09-07 (4 from 2026-08-20): four disjoint K=4 draws of the champion graded $2,218-$3,498 over 2006-2024 and K=16 $4,256, so the K=4 record was one draw's luck on top of the model; the record is the K=16 walk (ledger k16_champion_2006_2015_verdict, reports/k16_champion_record.md); selection.K_COPIES is pinned to this value by tests/test_r5.py
ensemble.method: WeekBootstrapEstimator: copy c = random_state c + whole-week bootstrap seeded by c; predictions averaged (replication.py)

strategy.weight: equal, re-leveled weekly (drift-threshold in live trading)
strategy.stop_action: none — audited 2026-09-01: stop measured mildly negative on dollars in the final configuration (as deployed, 2026-09-03: off $1,553 vs -25% $1,499, SR 0.72 vs 0.73, DD 62% vs 60%; close basis, fixed join: $1,644 vs $1,533, identical DD; before the rank-date fix, without the cap, $1,383 vs $1,296); removed for simplicity
strategy.sector_cap_note: max 2 of 6 per sector; blocked slots go to next-ranked name from another sector (adopted 2026-09-01: +0.9%/yr and better SR in every window on the champion, no DD effect; re-graded on the fixed join +0.3 to +1.9%/yr per window, +1.2%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024; as deployed (2026-09-03) +1.1%/yr and SR 0.67 -> 0.72 over 2006-2024, per window +2.1 / +0.5 / -0.1%/yr for 2006-12 / 2013-24 / 2021-24 with SR up or level in each)

ballast.ballast_asset: SPY, switched to IEF per trend state
ballast.trend_rule: one third of ballast to IEF per breached SPY trailing MA (30/40/52 weeks), evaluated weekly, point-in-time

panel: data/sharadar_world2000/panel_sf.parquet (price/volume + Sharadar fundamentals f_sf_* + insiders f_sfi_* + the screen's candidates x_*, features/candidates.py + the champion's generated bundle g_*, features/bundle.py on generated.raw_inputs)
features_note: The generated feature bundle (features/bundle.py; formulas above): 40 order-1 formulas over the raw inputs (the f_ columns before ranking, every SF1 field and its year-over-year change, the 8-K item counts, the nominal close), each ranked within the week. Selected mechanically on 2006-01 -> 2015-11 alone (ops/openfe_arm_v2.py --generated-only; preregistration openfe_arm_v3_generated_2006_2015): every candidate scored by the t statistic of its weekly Spearman IC with the 4-week demedianed return, then a greedy dedup in descending |t| against the 64 base features and each other (|corr| <= 0.9), the first 40 kept; no grading year read. Graded once out of sample with the champion's own walk (4w / 5y / K=4, from 2006-01): 2016-01 -> 2024-07 $863 (+28.5%/yr, SR 1.13, DD 36%) vs the clean line $590 (+23.2%/yr, SR 0.95, DD 42%), the ideas bundle $772 (+26.8%/yr, SR 1.06, DD 42%) and SPY $310; 2006-2015 in-sample $405 vs clean $263 vs ideas $396; 2006-01 -> 2024-07 $3,498 (+21.1%/yr, SR 0.88, DD 50%) vs SPY $608 (ledger openfe_arm_v3_generated_2016_2024, reports/openfe_arm_v3.md). Adopted by the owner 2026-09-06 in place of the screened ideas bundle (x_8k_distress_26w, x_cash_runway, x_dps_yoy, x_earn_react_mean4, x_earn_window, x_price_level, f_vol_chg_12w; adopted 2026-09-05, ledger champion_r5_7030_cap2_bundle, $772), whose thirty candidate ideas had been written after reading the whole 2006-2024 record — the asterisk this bundle does not carry (its one caveat: the input rule was written by someone who knows those ideas exist; the rule is generic — every field, one standard window). The model's matrix is feature_cols (the f_ columns) plus these forty, research and live alike (walk.extra_features; r5.SPEC['features']); build_world_panel computes the g_ columns from the formulas each week (generated.add_generated on generated.raw_inputs), the research panel_sf carries the same columns. Known about the bundle: its members are correlated with each other (mean |corr| 0.28; about a third of their variance is one factor — company size and nominal price), and one walk per arm measured no seed spread. Book, ballast, cap and stop are unchanged.

retune_policy.cadence: never on a calendar (nested experiment); structural triggers only
triggers: new data source / feature family passes the gate

honest_expectation: edge is era-concentrated (strong 2013-2020, index-matching in whipsaw/megacap regimes); pre-holdout numbers carry design-iteration shine; deployment sizing should assume SPY-like outcomes in adverse regimes

selection_procedure.note: Mechanical cascade, run in this order on the selection window only; validated by the nested test (nested3_v1, 2026-09-04: select on every week of 2006-2015, grade 2016-2024; nested3_v2 re-ran it with the feature screen under rule v3.1, 2026-09-05; nested2_v1 was its sampled predecessor). Model config is NOT searched (simple-DT fixed; tuning measured as noise). Run programmatically: `stocks-ml select --sel-start A --sel-end B [--eval-start C --eval-end D] [--screen]` (stages cached & resumable under data/experiments/).

steps.metric: cost-adjusted compounded return of the top-6 book (full population of the selection window)
top-6 edge vs random basket, paired on the weeks every window's population walk has (every week of the selection window since v3); all windows fully formed

steps.menu: the x_ candidates (features/candidates.py) as one bundle
steps.metric: probe: Newey-West t of 2 or more in size and the same IC sign in both halves of the window; the keepers ride a second population walk and enter iff the top-6 book's cost-adjusted compounded return is higher with them than without (v3.1, 2026-09-05; the paired HAC t is reported, not the rule). The champion carries the bundle nested3_v2 admitted (`features`, adopted 2026-09-05); a future screen's bundle enters the champion only on the owner's go

selection_procedure.metric_convention: engine choices (horizon, window, book) by cost-adjusted compounded return; risk layers (floor, stop, cap) by Sharpe — owner-ratified 2026-09-01, 'for now'; earlier campaigns ranked by pre-tax earnings
selection_procedure.measured_selection_inflation: champion vs the nested honest-procedure pick on 2016-2024, as deployed: clean $590 (+23.2%/yr) vs v3's $521 (+21.2%/yr), +1.9%/yr on dollars, ~0 on Sharpe (0.95 vs 1.00); with the bundle the nested cascade's own pick out-earns the champion's settings ($1,379 vs $772), so the champion's book/ballast carry no inflation there — the asterisk on the bundle's ideas is the caveat that remains. History: +3.4%/yr vs v2's $463 as deployed, +3.1 on the close basis with the fixed join, +3.8 as first graded
selection_procedure.constraints: No layer reads a sample (v3, 2026-09-04), and no layer reads a rank week whose forward label ends after the window (`selection.label_end`: 35 days for 4w, 14 for 1w; 2026-09-05) — at a window ending at the holdout's edge those weeks would be graded on holdout prices. A bundle the screen admits is graded as a separate "+ engineered features" line with an asterisk (the candidate ideas were written from the whole 2006-2024 record), beside the clean line, never in place of it; the owner adopted nested3_v2's bundle into the champion on 2026-09-05 (features_note), so the champion's own record now carries the asterisk.
